def validate_dependency_files(root,patterns,included=None):
    """Reject missing audit data before tests/native work or execution claims."""
    root=Path(root)
    names={name for pattern in patterns for name in AUDIT_FILES.get(pattern,())}
    for name in sorted(names):
        path=root/name
        if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('CPU audit dependency missing: '+name)
        if included is not None and name not in included:
            raise ValueError('CPU audit dependency missing from immutable payload: '+name)


def validate_groups(root,patterns):
    if len(set(patterns))!=len(patterns):raise ValueError('Duplicate CPU test group')
    for pattern in patterns:
        if not re.fullmatch(r'test_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py',pattern) or not (root/'tests'/pattern).is_file():
            raise ValueError('CPU test file missing or invalid: '+pattern)
    validate_dependency_files(root,patterns)


def discovered_cases(root,pattern):
    """Discover original test IDs without executing fixtures or test bodies."""
    validate_groups(Path(root),[pattern]);before=list(sys.path)
    def flatten(suite):
        for item in suite:
            if isinstance(item,unittest.TestSuite):yield from flatten(item)
            else:yield item
    try:
        cases=list(flatten(unittest.TestLoader().discover(str(Path(root)/'tests'),pattern=pattern)))
    finally:sys.path[:]=before
    ids=[case.id() for case in cases]
    if not ids or len(ids)!=len(set(ids)) or any(type(case).__name__=='_FailedTest' for case in cases):
        raise ValueError('CPU test discovery incomplete or ambiguous')
    return cases

def selection_request(document,patterns,package_id):
    """Bind an explicit unit subset to one owner and every registered group."""
    if (type(document) is not dict or set(document)!={'schema','package_id','patterns','expected_tests'}
        or document['schema']!='unit-selection-v1' or document['package_id']!=package_id
        or type(document['patterns']) is not dict or list(document['patterns'])!=list(patterns)
        or type(document['expected_tests']) is not int or document['expected_tests']<=0):
        raise ValueError('Unit selection requires exact package, registry order and positive expected count')
    for ids in document['patterns'].values():
        if ids is not None and (type(ids) is not list or not ids or any(type(x) is not str for x in ids)
            or len(ids)!=len(set(ids))):
            raise ValueError('Unit selection requires nonempty unique test IDs or null for a complete group')
    return document


def resolve_selection(root,patterns,document,package_id):
    """Discover only in the fresh CPU child, then reuse run_groups admission."""
    selection_request(document,patterns,package_id);selected={}
    for pattern in patterns:
        available=[case.id() for case in discovered_cases(root,pattern)]
        ids=document['patterns'][pattern]
        if ids is None:ids=available
        if not ids or ids!=[name for name in available if name in ids]:
            raise ValueError('Selected CPU test IDs missing, duplicated or reordered')
        selected[pattern]=ids
    if sum(map(len,selected.values()))!=document['expected_tests']:
        raise ValueError('Selected CPU test count differs from explicit request')
    return selected


def run_groups(root,capture,patterns,write,*,selected_cases=None):
    """Execute in registry order; failure stops before any later group or GPU."""
    root=Path(root);capture=Path(capture);validate_groups(root,patterns)
    if selected_cases is not None and (type(selected_cases) is not dict or set(selected_cases)!=set(patterns)):
        raise ValueError('Exact selected CPU test patterns required')
    if (capture/'cpu-tests.json').exists():raise FileExistsError('Fresh CPU test receipt required')
    for pattern in patterns:
        for suffix in ('.stdout.log','.stderr.log'):
            if (capture/(pattern+suffix)).exists():raise FileExistsError('Fresh CPU test logs required')
    before_path=list(sys.path);rows=[];loader=unittest.TestLoader()
    try:
        # Standard unittest discovery keeps this path during test bodies.
        # Selected discovery restores its private import path, so retain the
        # same sibling-fixture imports here and restore it on every exit.
        test_root=str(root/'tests')
        if test_root not in sys.path:sys.path.insert(0,test_root)
        for pattern in patterns:
            started=time.perf_counter()
            with (capture/(pattern+'.stdout.log')).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stdout,(capture/(pattern+'.stderr.log')).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stderr,contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout),contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
                selected=None
                if selected_cases is None:suite=loader.discover(str(root/'tests'),pattern=pattern)
                else:
                    selected=selected_cases[pattern];cases=discovered_cases(root,pattern);available={case.id():case for case in cases}
                    if (type(selected) is not list or not selected or any(type(x) is not str for x in selected)
                        or len(selected)!=len(set(selected)) or any(x not in available for x in selected)
                        or selected!=[case.id() for case in cases if case.id() in selected]):
                        raise ValueError('Selected CPU test IDs missing, duplicated or reordered')
                    suite=unittest.TestSuite([available[x] for x in selected])
                result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stderr,verbosity=1).run(suite)
                success=result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun>0 and (selected is None or result.testsRun==len(selected))
                if result.testsRun==0:stderr.write('Required CPU group discovered zero tests\n')
            rows.append(dict(pattern=pattern,exit_code=0 if success else 1,elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,
                tests=result.testsRun,failures=len(result.failures),errors=len(result.errors),skipped=len(result.skipped),runner_pid=os.getpid()))
            if selected is not None:rows[-1]['case_ids']=list(selected)
            write(capture/'cpu-tests.json',rows)
            if not success:break
        if not patterns:write(capture/'cpu-tests.json',rows)
    finally:sys.path[:]=before_path
    return rows


def complete(rows,patterns):
    return bool([r.get('pattern') for r in rows]==list(patterns) and all(type(r.get('exit_code')) is int and r['exit_code']==0 and type(r.get('tests')) is int and r['tests']>0 and r.get('failures')==0 and r.get('errors')==0 for r in rows))

def validate_dependency_files(root,patterns,included=None):
    """Reject missing audit data before tests/native work or execution claims."""
    root=Path(root)
    names={name for pattern in patterns for name in AUDIT_FILES.get(pattern,())}
    for name in sorted(names):
        path=root/name
        if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('CPU audit dependency missing: '+name)
        if included is not None and name not in included:
            raise ValueError('CPU audit dependency missing from immutable payload: '+name)


def validate_groups(root,patterns):
    if len(set(patterns))!=len(patterns):raise ValueError('Duplicate CPU test group')
    for pattern in patterns:
        if not re.fullmatch(r'test_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py',pattern) or not (root/'tests'/pattern).is_file():
            raise ValueError('CPU test file missing or invalid: '+pattern)
    validate_dependency_files(root,patterns)


def discovered_cases(root,pattern):
    """Discover original test IDs without executing fixtures or test bodies."""
    validate_groups(Path(root),[pattern]);before=list(sys.path)
    def flatten(suite):
        for item in suite:
            if isinstance(item,unittest.TestSuite):yield from flatten(item)
            else:yield item
    try:
        cases=list(flatten(unittest.TestLoader().discover(str(Path(root)/'tests'),pattern=pattern)))
    finally:sys.path[:]=before
    ids=[case.id() for case in cases]
    if not ids or len(ids)!=len(set(ids)) or any(type(case).__name__=='_FailedTest' for case in cases):
        raise ValueError('CPU test discovery incomplete or ambiguous')
    return cases

def selection_request(document,patterns,package_id):
    """Bind an explicit unit subset to one owner and every registered group."""
    if (type(document) is not dict or set(document)!={'schema','package_id','patterns','expected_tests'}
        or document['schema']!='unit-selection-v1' or document['package_id']!=package_id
        or type(document['patterns']) is not dict or list(document['patterns'])!=list(patterns)
        or type(document['expected_tests']) is not int or document['expected_tests']<=0):
        raise ValueError('Unit selection requires exact package, registry order and positive expected count')
    for ids in document['patterns'].values():
        if ids is not None and (type(ids) is not list or not ids or any(type(x) is not str for x in ids)
            or len(ids)!=len(set(ids))):
            raise ValueError('Unit selection requires nonempty unique test IDs or null for a complete group')
    return document


def resolve_selection(root,patterns,document,package_id):
    """Discover only in the fresh CPU child, then reuse run_groups admission."""
    selection_request(document,patterns,package_id);selected={}
    for pattern in patterns:
        available=[case.id() for case in discovered_cases(root,pattern)]
        ids=document['patterns'][pattern]
        if ids is None:ids=available
        if not ids or ids!=[name for name in available if name in ids]:
            raise ValueError('Selected CPU test IDs missing, duplicated or reordered')
        selected[pattern]=ids
    if sum(map(len,selected.values()))!=document['expected_tests']:
        raise ValueError('Selected CPU test count differs from explicit request')
    return selected


def run_groups(root,capture,patterns,write,*,selected_cases=None):
    """Execute in registry order; failure stops before any later group or GPU."""
    root=Path(root);capture=Path(capture);validate_groups(root,patterns)
    if selected_cases is not None and (type(selected_cases) is not dict or set(selected_cases)!=set(patterns)):
        raise ValueError('Exact selected CPU test patterns required')
    if (capture/'cpu-tests.json').exists():raise FileExistsError('Fresh CPU test receipt required')
    for pattern in patterns:
        for suffix in ('.stdout.log','.stderr.log'):
            if (capture/(pattern+suffix)).exists():raise FileExistsError('Fresh CPU test logs required')
    before_path=list(sys.path);rows=[];loader=unittest.TestLoader()
    try:
        # Standard unittest discovery keeps this path during test bodies.
        # Selected discovery restores its private import path, so retain the
        # same sibling-fixture imports here and restore it on every exit.
        test_root=str(root/'tests')
        if test_root not in sys.path:sys.path.insert(0,test_root)
        for pattern in patterns:
            started=time.perf_counter()
            with (capture/(pattern+'.stdout.log')).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stdout,(capture/(pattern+'.stderr.log')).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stderr,contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout),contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
                selected=None
                if selected_cases is None:suite=loader.discover(str(root/'tests'),pattern=pattern)
                else:
                    selected=selected_cases[pattern];cases=discovered_cases(root,pattern);available={case.id():case for case in cases}
                    if (type(selected) is not list or not selected or any(type(x) is not str for x in selected)
                        or len(selected)!=len(set(selected)) or any(x not in available for x in selected)
                        or selected!=[case.id() for case in cases if case.id() in selected]):
                        raise ValueError('Selected CPU test IDs missing, duplicated or reordered')
                    suite=unittest.TestSuite([available[x] for x in selected])
                result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stderr,verbosity=1).run(suite)
                success=result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun>0 and (selected is None or result.testsRun==len(selected))
                if result.testsRun==0:stderr.write('Required CPU group discovered zero tests\n')
            rows.append(dict(pattern=pattern,exit_code=0 if success else 1,elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,
                tests=result.testsRun,failures=len(result.failures),errors=len(result.errors),skipped=len(result.skipped),runner_pid=os.getpid()))
            if selected is not None:rows[-1]['case_ids']=list(selected)
            write(capture/'cpu-tests.json',rows)
            if not success:break
        if not patterns:write(capture/'cpu-tests.json',rows)
    finally:sys.path[:]=before_path
    return rows


def complete(rows,patterns):
    return bool([r.get('pattern') for r in rows]==list(patterns) and all(type(r.get('exit_code')) is int and r['exit_code']==0 and type(r.get('tests')) is int and r['tests']>0 and r.get('failures')==0 and r.get('errors')==0 for r in rows))
